# XR World Studio

## Controls

- Start button / menu toggle: press the Start button on the Xbox-style controller to open or close the floating menu.
- Left stick: while the menu is active, move the left stick to reposition the floating menu around you inside the circular move zone.
- A button: aim at a hitbox and press A to open its linked image, video, or audio file in the center of the XR view.
- Main Xbox button: press the center Xbox button to recenter the headset/world view.
- Look around: turn your head or device orientation to inspect the space and the floating menus.

## Notes

- This app is intended for personal XR use and is optimized for an immersive fullscreen experience.
- The menu stays in front of the user while the world remains the focus.
